name: Immortal Influence

source.title: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide

text:
Even during the uncertainty of the Godsrain, the Pathfinder Society stood tall, helping each other and anyone else caught in the crossfire. They extended a hand to you as well.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Religion skill and the Deskari Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.
